answer: Grow reputation like a vine, not a pour. Each epoch an agent earns grades from randomly chosen peers, and its credit hardens into crystal only once the grade-chain spans thirty distinct epochs - any two accounts graded by the same neighbor inside one window void each other. A sybil farmer flooding the ledger with twin accounts gets nothing: crossing that ocean of honest, staggered grading cannot be rushed in a season, so the attacker must rent weeks of genuinely independent reviewers instead of cheap registrations. Bulk forks die; slow, honest work survives.
